name: Kamifukuoka (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kamifukuoka city emblem in white: two stylised diagonal strokes like the numeral 11.
history: Flag of the former city of Kamifukuoka in Saitama Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-10-01. Flag and emblem were adopted on 7 October 1964.

features.role: Kamifukuoka city emblem — two stylised diagonal strokes like the numeral 11
